envelope.description: Route installed shell and TUI lifecycle through the supervisor

body.title: Route installed shell and TUI lifecycle through the supervisor
body.summary: Use one predecessor-bound restart in both entry points, stage the per-user launch job and require verified quiescence for legacy cutover. Add status and operator recovery access independent of a live daemon. Keep installed activation gated on end-to-end rollout readiness.
acceptanceChecks: Start, stop and restart share the installation gate and do not issue a second stop
CLI status shows recovery state when the daemon socket is unavailable

tests.name: Supervisor loss, concurrent restart and stale files
Managed Darwin never invokes the Mach broker from either the controller or shutdown watchdog
Installed controller refuses a verified job belonging to another test root
Kill the supervisor while it owns the guard and verify fail-closed operator recovery
Installed shell restart sends one stop and one start bound to the same predecessor
Race competing start, stop, raw shutdown and update against both supervisor versions
